page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.6xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 12 physical Intel Xeon 8369HB processor cores running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The x86_64 architecture includes 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 33 MB L3 cache. It is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8 GB per vCPU.

Benchmark results place this instance in the average performance tier across multiple workloads. It achieves a single-core stress-ng score of 1579.68 and a multi-core score of 24990.45, alongside a Geekbench multi-core score of 10175.0. Memory performance is highlighted by a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 1398.59 GB/sec, dropping to 86.33 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, and a PassMark memory score of 2637.51. For database operations, it processes 23.38 million Redis SET operations per second and scores 9254.37 in PassMark database benchmarks.

The instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, meaning all storage must be network-attached, and it is not configured for hardware-accelerated graphics or machine learning workloads. Network connectivity is supported by an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth. Given its high memory density and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.hfr7.6xlarge is suited for memory-intensive applications, database operations, software compilation, and static web serving.

It lacks local storage and GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmark data shows stable mid-tier performance, including a PassMark CPU score of 25234.51, a Redis SET throughput of 23.38 million operations per second, and a cached memory read bandwidth of 1398.59 GB/sec. This hardware profile makes the instance highly suitable for memory-intensive workloads, database management, and software compilation.
